title: Cache Freshness under Lost Invalidation Messages: Confirmatory Data and Reproducibility Package
description: Confirmatory data and reproducibility materials for a controlled study of application-cache freshness under lost invalidation messages. The deposit contains 450 prespecified paired estimates from 4,824 matched allocation blocks and 38,592 complete policy executions across three web workloads, three request/update regimes, Redis Pub/Sub and Streams, and no-fault plus 1%, 5% and 10% notification-loss conditions. It includes analysis-ready data, figure source data, the frozen protocol and analyzer, archive inventories and all raw GitHub Actions artifacts.
